issue.title: Enhancement: Enable kdump on Nexthop devices

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

To enable kdump to capture core dumps on Nexthop devices. This will help improve debuggability.

### Current Behavior

Kdump is not enabled on all Nexthop devices

### Proposed Behavior

Kdump is enabled on all Nexthop devices

resolution.title: Enable kdump on Nexthop devices
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

To enable kdump to capture core dumps on Nexthop devices. This will help improve debuggability.

NH-5010 already has kdump enabled in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/24169

Fixes #26134
